title: C. Digits
statement:
The first line contains a single integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 32) — the number of test cases.

Each test case contains n lines. The i-th line contains an integer a_i (1 ≤ a_i ≤ 9).

The sum of n over all test cases doesn't exceed 155.

For each test case, print one integer — the answer.

Input:
```
3
2
1
4
7
1
2
3
5
```

Output:
```
8
7
30
```
